endorsements.name: Xiaochen Zou
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-27645
endorsements.description: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of NETGEAR R6700v3 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within readycloud_control.cgi. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-15762.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.0, 8.8)
